verdict.rationale: Mesh lets users define their own rule logic: a configurable risk-score equation and multiple screening configurations. The platform also documents automatic actions on events, such as high-risk cases being auto-escalated to humans and level 1 alerts being auto-remediated by agents. However, the evidence never shows a general user-authored 'when event X, do action Y' rule builder, and Starter Plan agent configurations cannot be customized. Missing for 10: a documented user-defined event→action rule engine, clear evidence that user rules (not vendor agents) drive the automatic actions, customizable agent/automation configuration on all plans, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
